headings.usage: Use for all major headings (H1, H2, H3), apartment names. Tracking should be normal or slightly tight for large sizes.

body.usage: Use for body text, overlines, labels, buttons, navigation. Overlines should be uppercase with wide tracking (tracking-widest).

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal shadows, rely on 1px borders with low opacity (border-white/10).
visual_enhancers.overlays: Images must have max bg-black/40 overlay. Do not hide the beauty of the Alps.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise on dark backgrounds for a premium print feel.

layouts.spacing: Generous padding. Use py-24 or py-32 for main sections.
layouts.hero: h-screen flex flex-col justify-center relative. Image as background with object-cover. Content centered or bottom-left aligned.
layouts.bento_grid: Use asymmetric grids for image galleries or featured content.
layouts.cards: Minimalist. Image on top, text below. No card background, no border. Just the image and typography.

booking_widget.style: A distinct rectangular block (can float over hero or sit below). Dark grey background (bg-zinc-900), 1px border (border-white/20). Inside: A highly visible dashed container (border-dashed border-zinc-600 p-6) with text 'Widget di prenotazione Octorate - incolla qui lo script embed'. Below/around it, a mock UI: Input fields for 'Check-in / Check-out', 'Ospiti' (Adulti, Bambini dropdown mock), and a large solid CTA button 'Cerca disponibilità' in dark green (#2E4F3E).

buttons.primary: bg-[#2E4F3E] text-white hover:bg-[#233B2E] transition-colors duration-300 px-8 py-4 text-sm tracking-widest uppercase font-medium
buttons.outline: border border-white text-white hover:bg-white hover:text-black transition-colors duration-300 px-8 py-4 text-sm tracking-widest uppercase font-medium

inputs.style: bg-transparent border-b border-white/20 text-white focus:border-white focus:outline-none py-3 placeholder:text-white/40 font-manrope rounded-none transition-colors

navbar.style: fixed w-full top-0 z-50 transition-all duration-300 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-white/10. Links are Manrope, uppercase, tracking-wider, text-xs or text-sm.

motion.scroll: Use Lenis (if configured) or smooth scrolling. Sections should fade in and translate slightly up on scroll (Framer Motion 'whileInView').
motion.hover: Images in cards should have overflow-hidden and scale up (scale-105) softly on hover. Buttons should have color transitions.

Home.Hero: Full-screen background image of Alpine snow. Large centered text 'OUTDOOR APARTMENTS' in Playfair Display. Subtitle 'La tua vacanza in montagna a Pila'.
Home.Booking_Widget: Positioned overlapping the bottom of the hero or right underneath it in a dark section.
Home.Chi_siamo: Split layout. Left: Large image of a chalet interior with view. Right: Text 'L'ospitalità in alta quota', description, and a link to read more.
Home.Featured_Apartments: 2x2 grid of featured apartments. Image-heavy cards, minimal text.
Home.CTA_Section: Banner image with text asking owners to trust us with their property. Button to 'Affidaci il tuo immobile'.

Appartamenti.Header: Clean, minimal header (50vh) with title 'I nostri appartamenti' and a short description.
Appartamenti.List: Grid (1 col mobile, 2 col tablet, 3 col desktop) of all 8 apartments. Each card shows image, title, location (Pila, Valle d'Aosta), review score (e.g., ★ 4.9), and icon amenities (lucide-react icons for bed, bath, wifi). Clicking a card goes to detail page.

Dettaglio_Appartamento.Hero: Full screen image of the selected apartment.
Dettaglio_Appartamento.Content: Main column (2/3 width) with description, photo gallery, and features. Sidebar (1/3 width, sticky) containing the 'Prenota ora' widget (Octorate placeholder mock UI).

Affidaci_Immobile.Content: Elegant page with a split layout. Left side: Persuasive copy about maximizing rental income in Pila. Right side: Minimalist contact form (Name, Phone, Address, Email, Description) using bottom-border inputs and a dark green CTA.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a premium, high-end editorial website inspired by lavi82.com, using React and Tailwind CSS.
Use a predominantly dark theme (Black, Dark Grey) with White text and Dark Green (#2E4F3E) accents. DO NOT use beige.
Load Google Fonts: 'Playfair Display' for all headings and 'Manrope' for body/UI text.
Implement fluid scroll animations using framer-motion (e.g., initial opacity 0, y 20 -> opacity 1, y 0 on whileInView).

For the Octorate widget, build a very clear placeholder: A block with a dashed border that explicitly says 'Widget di prenotazione Octorate - incolla qui lo script embed', alongside a mock UI (Dates, Guests, Search button) to show how it should look.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
Do not use generic Shadcn cards for apartments; build custom minimalist HTML/Tailwind structures where the image is the hero.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds for the sticky navbar; use a dark semi-transparent color with backdrop-blur.
Build pages using React Router or equivalent if it's a multi-page app structure, or handle view switching via state if single page.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
